fusions.name: Halting Command
fusions.desc: Barks a practised command at an enemy within 5 tiles, dealing 10 damage, stunning it for 1 second and taking its next action away for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Clicked Cantrip
fusions.desc: Clicks your tongue to send a bolt of arcana at the first enemy it meets, dealing 4 damage. Its damage rises 4% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max +20%).

fusions.name: Dressage Drill
fusions.desc: Increases your casting speed by 25% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Rehearsed Gaits
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 8% sooner.
